task: SPEC-065/pre-T009 fixes of the delta security review (evidence/probe-catalog-delta-review.md)
decisionChannel: Founder answers to interactive questions in the orchestrator chat, 2026-11-02, recorded verbatim by the derived closer track. Additive to founder-decisions-20261102.json and founder-decisions-20261102b.json.

decisions.item: The 2 GiB / 100,000-file disk bound did not cover the dedicated user's config_dir (RV-19 follow-up)

decision.enforcement: the supervisor measures the candidate directory, the per-run TMPDIR and the dedicated user's config_dir together on each poll; the total includes what config_dir already holds
decision.liveProbe: opt-in live control only (BRAID_T007_LIVE_CONTROLS=1): LiveDiskBoundProbeTests creates the real 100,000+ entries in temporary directories and checks the guard; no sandbox, no claude, no network. It is not a catalog attempt and never runs in CI.

decisions.detail: Supersedes the 'config_dir is not measured' sentence of evidence/t005-review-fixes.json and the 'plus TMPDIR' wording of founder-decisions-20261102.json (RV-19). The bound stays a polled threshold (DRV-07 residual). No baseline is subtracted, so a config_dir that has grown refuses later runs (fail closed).

decisions.item: NC-11 pre-session subset runs under both the fixture and the launch-probe profiles with connect-level NET-01 attempts

decision.reading: the five NC-11 probes (FS-01, NET-01, CRED-01, PROC-01, NET-06) run once per profile and must agree; NET-01 attempts a loopback listener, a public literal and, as tripwire, a name; a disagreement or non-denial refuses the session
decision.strictness: stricter than the NC-11 text; it cannot produce a pass that NC-11 would refuse

decisions.detail: The make_f4_probe_runner launch_profile=False knob and runner_options overrides remain test-only and must not be used in T009 (quickstart.md).

limits: Records two founder decisions only. No native session or probe was run and nothing here qualifies the Claude profile, issues a qualification record or authorizes T009 or any execution. Any change needs a new founder decision record.
